checkedAlternates.risk: Humus is concentrated in the O-horizon.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Humus is the decomposed organic substance itself (group-1), whereas O/A/B/C are vertical depth layers in a soil profile (group-4).
Sandy Loam is a USDA composite texture class mixing sand, silt, and clay (group-3), not a single-size mineral particle fraction (group-2).
